title: Release 1.26.0: field lessons 99–111, local config, ship timing
head: swarm-1.26-lessons
body:
## Summary

Release 1.26.0 carries field lessons 99–111 (see `docs/lessons.md`).

- Probes resolve a check's program the way the check will (explicit search-path prefix first) and name every directory tried (99).
- Mutants files accept two documentation-only fields with a warning; a claimed killer test is compared with what actually failed (100).
- A worker that answered is never reported as empty: one narrow repair, else the raw reply's location and excerpt (101).
- A job that never started says so, with the setup failure's log tail; validate warns on a lock naming a missing local path (102).
- `integrate` refuses by default on a failed check (`--accept-failed-checks` to opt in) (103).
- Validate warns when a sandboxed worker is told to run a check it cannot reach (104).
- `check-pins`: new `pin-not-vendored` rule for an exact internal pin with no vendored wheel and no local source (105).
- `ship` scratch guard reads the real diff, not declared outputs (106).
- `integrate --salvage` for timed-out jobs, shell workers run only their own tests, timeout names last activity, full-suite overlap warning (107).
- `newPersistedFields` in shell results, with an inspect warning when a persisted field is added without a stated legacy default (108).
- Cheap-tier routing warning (109).
- Project-specific keychain service, rig port file and denied home directories now come only from local config (`loadLocalConfig`), with generic defaults (110).
- API adapter errors name the provider's finish reason (111).
- `ship` timing fields: `checksSeconds`, `ciWaitSeconds`, `attempts`, `rerunCount`.

**Behavior change for existing users:** with no local config, no product-specific home directory is denied and the rig-port loopback deny is off. Set them in `~/.project-swarm/config.json` before upgrading.

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

- Orchestrator full run after integrating the last job: `npm test` 869 tests, 867 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed; `git diff --check` passed.

## Mutation check

No ask-first gate or persisted-state mapping in this tool. Red proof instead: the new lesson tests were run against the 1.25.0 `tools/` on a temporary tree. `field-lessons-batch-m1`: all 6 behavior tests fail (3 negative controls pass, as intended). `field-lessons-batch-l`, `-m2`, `-m3`: fail at import (new exports missing), so the proof for those three is coarse. `swarm redcheck` could not run on stacked runs (tracked for the next release).
